summary: This is a clipped reference page for the ALTER INTEGRATION command, which modifies the properties of an existing integration. It gives the general syntax ALTER <integration_type> INTEGRATION <object_name> <actions>, where the actions depend on the integration type. The page points to other pages for type-specific syntax, usage notes, and examples, but those details are not included in this note. Most of the remaining text is navigation and boilerplate.
one_line: Reference page describing the general syntax for the ALTER INTEGRATION command, which modifies existing integrations.
key_facts: ALTER INTEGRATION modifies the properties for an existing integration.
The general syntax is ALTER <integration_type> INTEGRATION <object_name> <actions>.
The <actions> portion of the syntax is specific to the object type.
The page refers readers to separate pages for specific syntax, usage notes, and examples.
The page is categorized under General, API, Catalog, External access, Notification, Security, and Storage navigation sections.
